name: Basil Pinegar
source: June’s doting father and the owner and head chef of the café. Passionate and driven, he can sometimes get a little too lost in his work. His and June’s relationship is shaky at best, but he hopes to change that over the course of the summer. He has an unhealthy love for coffee and the classic TV show “Star Journey”.
